- C→A (**state-derived**): "The seller closing contribution is not worked out until the payoff case carries an approved short-sale allowance for its closing costs." Case allowed_closing_costs 0 → unmet. "Short-Sale Approval" sets "the allowed closing costs" on the case.

- S→P (**state-derived**): "The short-sale statement balance is fixed only after the payoff case carries a recorded per diem for the statement date." per_diem 0. "Short-Sale Daily Accrual": "the per diem recorded is the short-sale daily accrual".
